scope: New equipment-reference specifications and overview UI strings for Thai and Indonesian, based on the accepted English equipment page.
translation_method: Assistant translation and editing against the accepted English source, followed by independent assistant semantic review.

google_translate_attempts.web_open_result: The official translation page was also inaccessible through web open.
google_translate_attempts.draft_note: No Google Translate draft was obtained for these new strings. No draft or Google attribution has been invented.

review.reviewer_type: Independent assistant semantic review; not a native-speaker or certified translation review.
review.findings: Thai and Indonesian text preserves the accepted scope; no additional certifications, material grades, model claims, capacities or other specifications were introduced.
indonesian_edits: The slurry mixer name uses Suspensi (Slurry) to align with the existing Indonesian glossary and retain the industry term.
The high-speed shearing remark uses Proses geser berkecepatan tinggi to avoid suggesting equipment shifting or sliding.

checks: The dimensions, power values and numeric-token sequences in every remark match the English source.
The number and order of records and remarks match the English source.
Technical identifiers PSS-3, K, CB7, NSK and pH are preserved, along with mm, MPa, kW and L units.
English UI copy matches the original accepted helper strings.

terminology_notes: Thai uses บุก and ผงบุก; Indonesian uses konjak and Tepung Konjak consistently with the current site.
The hydration-and-mixing tank name describes mixing konjac powder with water for hydration; it does not imply thermal puffing.
Ambiguous engineering wording in the accepted English source remains within that source's stated scope; missing units or disputed specifications have not been inferred.
historical_translation_records: Existing Google draft records for earlier site localization were not overwritten. This provenance record applies only to the new equipment-reference strings.
